papers.title: Agent in a Bottle: Can LLM Agents Turn Their Capabilities Into Cheap, Scalable Artifacts?
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) can solve many narrow tasks, but querying them separately for millions of related instances can be prohibitively expensive. Can LLM agents autonomously create cheaper solutions for such workloads? We call this ability "bottling": the ability to turn general capabilities into task-specific solutions that balance answer quality and amortised cost. papers.title: AdvSim2Real : Training Web Agents Against Adaptive Prompt Injection in a Web World Model
papers.abstract: Web agents complete user requests by reading and acting on pages that third parties write, so an instruction planted on a page can redirect the agent away from the user's goal. The agent cannot simply ignore the page, because the page also holds the values and controls the task requires. Current defenses fine-tune the agent on injections fixed before training, and attackers that adapt to the trained model bypass them. Adversarial training lets the attacker adapt but keeps the tasks fixed, so a t
papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08773）：AdvSim2Real 把 web agent 对抗 prompt injection 的训练从'攻击固定 / 任务固定'推到'attacker 在 web world model 里 adaptive + 任务自适应'——adversarial training 的 attacker 跟着训练适应，固定 task 改 adaptive task。是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × security-governance 的 adaptive adversarial training in world-model simulator 即时资产——adaptive-attacker-in-simulator 范式可迁移到任何'sim-to-real agent robustness'子方向（tool-use agent / code agent / browser agent），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × security-governance 主线在'adaptive adversarial training as security lever'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 world model 形式化（页面 / 控件 / 第三方内容建模）、adaptive protocol（attacker 怎么 adapt）、跨 web agent baseline 对照（WebArena / Mind2Web）、sim-to-real generalization 协议。

papers.title: VeriFine: Scaling Verification for Self-Improvement in Embodied Reasoning
papers.abstract: Self-improving policies continually expose new failure patterns, changing what their judges must be able to verify. However, current fixed judges constrain both optimization feedback and the discovery of useful training examples, limiting further self-improvement. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08761）：VeriFine 把 embodied reasoning 的 self-improvement 从'fixed judge 限制 feedback 信号 + 发现新训练样本'拉到'agent harness scaling verification（spatially-grounded / causal / safety-aware verify）'——self-improving policy 持续暴露新 failure pattern，judge 必须跟着 scale 才能继续给 feedback。是 ai-agent × multimodal-agent × llm-evaluation 的 scaling verification for embodied self-improvement 即时资产——scaling verification as policy enabler 范式可迁移到任何'self-improvement loop 需要 scalable verifier'子方向（code agent / tool-use agent / multi-step planning），与 aiutil 长期关注的 ai-agent × llm-evaluation 主线在'verification as policy enabler'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 harness 形式化（verify 协议 / spatial grounding 实现）、跨 embodied reasoning task 验证、self-improvement loop 公开性、与 fixed-judge baseline 对照。

papers.title: DepthWorld: 3D World Model for Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: World models offer a data-driven alternative to traditional simulators for robotics, with applications spanning policy evaluation, improvement, and planning. All of these uses depend on faithful 3D geometry, yet current video-based world models are trained on RGB alone and produce rollouts that look correct frame-by-frame but do not compose into a consistent 3D world. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08780）：DepthWorld 把 robot world model 从'RGB-only video rollouts 看起来对但 compose 不成 3D 一致性'推到'3D-supervised + depth-grounded world model（吸收大规模 3D 监督 + architecture 能 ingest 3D）'——visual fidelity 不等于 geometric consistency，必须有 explicit 3D supervision 才行。是 multimodal-agent × ai-agent × context-engineering 的 depth-grounded robot world model 趋势资产——3D-supervised world model 范式可迁移到任何'visual rollout 要 compose 成可规划一致性'子方向（manipulation planning / policy evaluation / world-model rollout），与昨日 Recursive Video ICL（frame-level rollout）在'agent geometry-aware memory'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 3D supervision 形式化、architecture design、跨 robot task 验证、与 RGB-only baseline 对照。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。

papers.title: QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients
papers.abstract: Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08789）：QF3（Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients）把 robot RL 从'flow policy + 完整 critic action gradient backprop through one-step flow prediction'推到'filter Q-gradients——mask out low-critic-confidence actions，只 backprop critic-high-confidence region'——更新只发生在 critic 确定的地方，避开 critic 不确定区域。是 multimodal-agent × ai-agent × inference-serving 的 filtered Q-gradient flow RL 趋势资产——filtered critic gradient 范式可迁移到任何'flow policy + critic RL'子方向（diffusion policy / action-chunking transformer / offline-to-online RL），与 aiutil 长期关注的 inference-serving × ai-agent 主线在'critic-confidence as update gate'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 filter 形式化（confidence threshold / non-conformity score）、跨 robot task 验证、与 unfiltered critic gradient baseline 对照。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。

papers.title: IdeaAnchor: Teaching LLMs to Turn Literature into Research Ideas
papers.abstract: Scientific research often begins by synthesizing ideas from a set of related papers to identify gaps and formulate new directions. However, training language models to perform this form of literature-grounded ideation remains challenging, as existing approaches based on prompting or feedback lack structured supervision for how papers should be synthesized. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08781）：IdeaAnchor 把 LLM-driven research ideation 从'prompting / feedback 缺乏结构化 supervision'拉到'structured specifications as privileged signals（每篇 paper 都给结构化 spec，训练 LLM 在 literature 之上做 ideation）'。是 llm-evaluation × ai-agent × context-engineering 的 structured specification ideation 趋势资产——structured-spec-as-privileged-signal 范式可迁移到任何'LLM 在 corpus 上做 reasoning / synthesis'子方向（literature-grounded QA / survey / research direction generation），与 aiutil 长期关注的 llm-evaluation × context-engineering 主线在'structured spec as training signal'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 spec 形式化（spec schema / training pipeline）、跨 ideation task 验证、与 prompt-only baseline 对照。今日维持趋势卡片并设置 7 天观察周期。

papers.title: Conformal Prediction Sets Quantify Information Gain: A Theoretical Perspective
papers.abstract: Conformal prediction is a popular tool for uncertainty quantification that outputs prediction sets with finite-sample coverage guarantees. While prediction set size is commonly used as a heuristic measure of uncertainty, the information-theoretic basis for this interpretation remains poorly understood. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2610.08785）：Conformal Prediction Sets Quantify Information Gain 把 conformal prediction 的 prediction set size 从'启发式 uncertainty measure'拉到'decision-theoretic generalization of entropy tailored to set-valued prediction（generalized information measure family）'——给 set size 一个信息论 foundation。是 llm-evaluation 的 set-entropy-based conformal-prediction 长尾理论资产——set-valued information measure 范式可迁移到任何'conformal prediction / selective prediction / abstention'子方向（LLM abstention / retrieval calibration / uncertainty-aware agent），与 aiutil 长期关注的 llm-evaluation 主线在'formal foundation for set size'层面同源。代码/benchmark/项目页：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 generalized entropy 形式化、跨 conformal baseline 对照。今日维持长尾卡片。
